name: Turn Cloud Technology Service Inc.
summary: Turn Cloud Technology Service Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides digital transformation solutions for commercial real estate operators, brand operators, wholesalers, and various types of retailers in Taiwan and rest of Asia.
